title: RoleScopeClaim payload
description: One line of a role brief: what the hire will really do, read from the ad, the hiring manager's notes and public research on the hiring company (owner, 2026-10-19: 'read between the lines'). Each line says where it comes from; a reading of ours may carry one question for whoever uploaded the job. Never personality, culture or fit, never a person's name.

facet.description: situation: where the company stands that matters for the hire; core_work: the work at the heart of the role; team: around the hire; hands_on: how much of the work they do themselves; market: the company's presence in the market the role serves; reports_to: to whom and where; level: the level the scope implies.

value.description: team: works_alone | small_team | leads_a_team | joins_a_team; hands_on: hands_on | mixed | manages_managers; market: entering | growing | established; level: a career-profile level. Null for the facets said in words only.

basis.description: Where it comes from. ad, notes and research are quoted (the quote is the evidence); reading is ours, inferred.

question.description: For a reading that changes whom to look for: the one question that would settle it.

why.description: Why the question matters, in a few words.
